pdf-car-report.title: Make a PDF
pdf-car-report.description: Generate a cool classic car value report based on the vehicle you drive (or just have parked in the garage).
pdf-car-report.chip: Create a report for my car
pdf-car-report.prompt: Create a one-page PDF value report for the car I drive. Ask me the make, model and year first if you do not know them.

pdf-proposal.title: Make a proposal PDF
pdf-proposal.description: A one-page proposal or quote you can send today.
pdf-proposal.chip: Draft a quote for a new client
pdf-proposal.prompt: Create a one-page PDF proposal for a new client. Ask me what we sell, the client's name and the price, then produce the PDF.

pdf-chore-chart.title: Make a chore chart
pdf-chore-chart.description: A printable weekly chart for the fridge.
pdf-chore-chart.prompt: Make a printable weekly chore chart as a PDF. Ask me the kids' names and ages first, then suggest age-appropriate chores.

draft-doc.title: Draft a document
draft-doc.description: Write a first draft in the editor and iterate together.
draft-doc.prompt: Open a new document and draft a one-page announcement. Ask me three questions about what I am announcing first.

edit-my-doc.title: Polish my writing
edit-my-doc.description: Paste anything and get suggestions you can accept one by one.
edit-my-doc.prompt: I will paste something I wrote. Put it in a document and give me suggestions to make it shorter and clearer, one by one.

meeting-notes.title: Turn notes into a summary
meeting-notes.description: Paste messy notes, get decisions and action items.
meeting-notes.prompt: I will paste rough meeting notes. Turn them into a summary with decisions, action items with owners, and open questions.

sop-doc.title: Write a how-to for your team
sop-doc.description: Turn a process in your head into a checklist anyone can follow.
sop-doc.chip: Document how we onboard a customer
sop-doc.prompt: Help me write a step-by-step how-to for a process my team repeats. Interview me for five minutes, then write it as a checklist in a document.

school-letter.title: Write a note to school
school-letter.description: An absence note or a teacher email in your voice.
school-letter.prompt: Write a short absence note for my child's school for tomorrow. Ask me the child's name, class and reason.

campaign-tracker.title: Build a campaign tracker
campaign-tracker.description: A small app to track campaigns, owners and status.
campaign-tracker.prompt: Build me a simple campaign tracker app with columns for campaign, channel, owner, status and launch date.

analytics-dashboard.title: Make a dashboard from a CSV
analytics-dashboard.description: Drop in a spreadsheet, get charts.
analytics-dashboard.prompt: Create a dashboard app from a CSV I upload, with one chart per numeric column and a summary at the top.

content-calendar.title: Plan a content calendar
content-calendar.description: A month of posts at a glance.
content-calendar.prompt: Build a content calendar app for the next 30 days with slots for blog, social and newsletter, and let me drag posts between days.

idea-tree.title: Brainstorm as a tree
idea-tree.description: Branching ideas you can keep expanding.
idea-tree.chip: Idea tree for a side project
idea-tree.prompt: Make an idea tree app: I give a topic, you branch it three levels deep and let me expand any node.

invoice-tracker.title: Track unpaid invoices
invoice-tracker.description: Who owes what, and when it was due.
invoice-tracker.prompt: Build a small app to track invoices: client, amount, sent date, due date, paid or not, with overdue rows highlighted.

inventory-app.title: Count your stock
inventory-app.description: A simple inventory list with low-stock flags.
inventory-app.prompt: Build an inventory app: item, quantity on hand, reorder point, supplier. Flag anything below its reorder point.

family-board.title: Build a family board
family-board.description: Who is where this week, on one screen.
family-board.prompt: Build a family week board app with a column per person and a row per day. Ask me who is in the family first.

allowance-tracker.title: Track allowance and chores
allowance-tracker.description: Points, payouts and streaks for the kids.
allowance-tracker.prompt: Build an allowance app: chores with point values, a tally per child, streaks, and a weekly payout summary.

meal-planner.title: Plan the week's meals
meal-planner.description: A menu plus a grocery list you can tick off.
meal-planner.prompt: Build a meal planner app for this week with a dinner per night and an auto-generated grocery list I can tick off. Ask about allergies first.

habit-tracker.title: Track a habit
habit-tracker.description: One tap a day, streaks included.
habit-tracker.prompt: Build a habit tracker app for up to five habits with one-tap check-ins and streak counts.

price-quote-calc.title: Build a pricing calculator
price-quote-calc.description: Inputs in, a quote out, shareable with customers.
price-quote-calc.prompt: Build a pricing calculator app for what I sell. Ask me the inputs that change the price, then make the calculator.

connect-email.title: Connect your inbox
connect-email.description: Let your assistant read and draft email for you.
connect-email.prompt: Help me connect my email account so you can read and draft messages for me. Walk me through it.

inbox-sweep.title: Sweep your inbox
inbox-sweep.description: Unsubscribe, archive, and surface what matters.
inbox-sweep.prompt: Sweep my inbox: propose newsletters to unsubscribe from, old threads to archive, and the five emails I should answer today. Ask before changing anything.

daily-briefing.title: Get a morning briefing
daily-briefing.description: Calendar, email and weather in one message every morning.
daily-briefing.prompt: Set up a daily morning briefing at 7am with my calendar, important email and the weather. Ask me which channel you should send it to.

calendar-find-time.title: Find time for a meeting
calendar-find-time.description: Check your calendar and propose slots.
calendar-find-time.prompt: Look at my calendar and propose three 30-minute slots this week for a meeting. Draft the invite text too.

draft-replies.title: Draft replies to customers
draft-replies.description: Pre-written answers for the emails waiting on you.
draft-replies.prompt: Find the customer emails waiting on me and draft a reply for each in my tone. Show me the drafts before sending.

school-emails.title: Catch school emails
school-emails.description: Never miss a permission slip again.
school-emails.prompt: Watch my inbox for emails from my kids' school and send me a short summary with any deadlines the same day. Ask me the school's email domain first.

set-schedule.title: Set up a schedule
set-schedule.description: Want a reminder? An everyday inbox sweep? Go wild.
set-schedule.prompt: Set up a recurring schedule for me. Propose three useful daily or weekly routines and set up the one I choose.

weekly-report.title: Get a weekly business recap
weekly-report.description: Every Friday: what happened, what is due next week.
weekly-report.prompt: Set up a weekly recap every Friday at 4pm covering what happened this week and what is due next week, using whatever you can see. Ask me what to include.

sunday-ping.title: Sunday planning ping
sunday-ping.description: A message every Sunday with the week ahead.
sunday-ping.prompt: Set up a Sunday 6pm message that previews the family's week: appointments, school events and anything I told you to remember.

watcher.title: Watch a web page
watcher.description: Get told when a page changes.
watcher.chip: Tell me when this price drops
watcher.prompt: Watch a web page for me and message me when it changes. Ask me for the URL and what change matters.

bill-reminders.title: Never miss a bill
bill-reminders.prompt: Set up reminders for my recurring bills three days before each is due. Ask me for the bills and their due dates.

blog-post.title: Write a blog post
blog-post.prompt: Write a 700-word blog post. Ask me for the topic and audience, show me an outline, then draft it in a document.

social-posts.title: Post to socials
social-posts.description: Turn one idea into three posts.
social-posts.prompt: Turn one announcement into a LinkedIn post, an X post and a short newsletter blurb. Ask me what I am announcing.

newsletter.title: Draft a newsletter
newsletter.prompt: Draft this week's newsletter with a subject line, a short intro and three sections. Ask me what happened this week.

image-asset.title: Make a social image
image-asset.description: A share-ready graphic in your colors.
image-asset.prompt: Create a 1200x630 social image for an announcement. Ask me for the headline and my brand color.

seo-audit.title: Check your site's SEO
seo-audit.description: A quick audit with the five fixes that matter most.
seo-audit.prompt: Audit my website for SEO and AI-search visibility and give me the five highest-impact fixes. Ask me for the URL.

google-review-replies.title: Reply to reviews
google-review-replies.description: Warm replies to your latest customer reviews.
google-review-replies.prompt: I will paste three customer reviews. Write a warm, specific reply to each in my business's voice.

meme-generator.title: Make a meme
meme-generator.prompt: Make me a meme. Ask me for the topic and pick a fitting template.

research-competitors.title: Size up a competitor
research-competitors.description: What they charge, what they claim, where you win.
research-competitors.prompt: Research a competitor and give me a one-page comparison: pricing, positioning, and three places we can win. Ask me for their website and mine.

compare-products.title: Compare before you buy
compare-products.description: Three options, one table, a recommendation.
compare-products.prompt: Help me choose a product. Ask me what I am buying and my budget, then compare three options in a table and recommend one.

plan-a-trip.title: Plan a family trip
plan-a-trip.prompt: Plan a family trip. Ask me where, when, who is coming and the budget, then give me a day-by-day itinerary and a packing list.

restaurant-reservation.title: Book a table
restaurant-reservation.description: Find a spot and reserve it.
restaurant-reservation.prompt: Find a restaurant and book a table. Ask me the city, day, party size and what we feel like eating.

weather-plan.title: Plan the weekend by the weather
weather-plan.description: Kid-friendly ideas that match the forecast.
weather-plan.chip: What should we do this weekend?
weather-plan.prompt: Check this weekend's weather where I live and suggest three kid-friendly plans that fit it. Ask me my city and the kids' ages.

reorder-essentials.title: Reorder essentials
reorder-essentials.description: Ask, and it lands at your door.
reorder-essentials.prompt: Help me set up reordering of household essentials. Ask me what I run out of most.

expense-summary.title: Summarize expenses
expense-summary.description: Drop in a statement, get categories and totals.
expense-summary.prompt: I will upload a bank or card statement export. Categorize the expenses, total each category, and flag anything unusual.

budget-plan.title: Make a family budget
budget-plan.description: Income, fixed costs, and what is left, by month.
budget-plan.prompt: Build a monthly family budget with me. Ask about income and fixed costs, then show what is left and suggest three savings.

teach-memory.title: Teach it about you
teach-memory.description: Names, routines, pet peeves. It remembers.
teach-memory.chip: Here's what you should know about me
teach-memory.prompt: Ask me ten quick questions about my life and work so you can remember what matters. Save what you learn.

add-contacts.title: Add your people
add-contacts.description: Save the contacts it should know by name.
add-contacts.prompt: Help me add the people I mention most as contacts so you know who I mean. Ask me for names and how I know them.

voice-mode.title: Talk instead of type
voice-mode.prompt: Help me set up voice so I can talk to you instead of typing, then let's have a short voice conversation.

connect-telegram.title: Chat from your phone
connect-telegram.description: Reach your assistant on Telegram, WhatsApp or SMS.
connect-telegram.prompt: Help me connect a messaging channel so I can text you from my phone. Show me the options and set up the one I pick.

connect-slack.title: Add it to Slack
connect-slack.description: Ask questions where your team already is.
connect-slack.prompt: Help me add you to my team's Slack workspace so we can ask you things in a channel.

connect-notion.title: Connect Notion
connect-notion.description: Read and write your team's pages.
connect-notion.prompt: Help me connect Notion so you can read and update our pages, then summarize one page I pick.

import-chatgpt.title: Bring your ChatGPT history
import-chatgpt.description: Import past chats so it starts with context.
import-chatgpt.prompt: Help me import my ChatGPT history so you know what I have been working on.

faq-page.title: Write your FAQ
faq-page.description: The ten questions customers keep asking, answered once.
faq-page.prompt: Write an FAQ page for my business. Ask me what I sell and the questions I get most, then draft ten answers in a document.

birthday-tracker.title: Never forget a birthday
birthday-tracker.description: A nudge a week before, with gift ideas.
birthday-tracker.prompt: Set up birthday reminders a week ahead with three gift ideas each. Ask me for the people and dates.

weekly-review.title: Reflect on your week
weekly-review.description: Three questions every Friday, saved as a journal.
weekly-review.prompt: Every Friday at 5pm ask me three short reflection questions and save my answers to a journal document.

try-computer-use.title: Try computer use
try-computer-use.description: Let your assistant see your screen and click around for you. Needs the desktop app.
try-computer-use.chip: Show me what computer use can do
try-computer-use.prompt: Show me what you can do with computer use on my machine. Start by taking a screenshot and describing what is on my screen, then suggest two things you could do for me.
